name: JMJ Fintech Limited
about: JMJ Fintech Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financial services to corporate clients and high net worth individuals in India. It also finances SME sector; and acts as a consultant to the organizations for raising funds, including capital through IPO/PE/venture funds. In addition, the company acts as a management consultant relating to areas, such as mergers, amalgamation, acquisition, valuation, etc. Further, it invests and trades in shares and securities; and invests in cash and derivative markets. The company was formerly known as Meenakshi Enterprises Limited and changed its name to JMJ Fintech Limited in June 2022. JMJ Fintech Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
